rules.title: Strong PPS: stem + -este / -emos / -eram
rules.text: For most strong preterites, tu, nós and eles are the eu-stem plus -este, -emos, -eram (tiv-: tiveste, tivemos, tiveram). Exceptions: ir/ser (foste, fomos, foram), dar (deste, demos, deram), ver (viste, vimos, viram).

rules.title: Eu/ele vowel flip
rules.text: Eu takes the high vowel, ele the mid vowel: fui/foi, tive/teve, estive/esteve, pude/pôde, pus/pôs, fiz/fez.

rules.title: Eu = ele
rules.text: Eu and ele are identical: disse, quis, soube, trouxe.

rules.title: Ir and ser share one PPS
rules.text: fui, foste, foi, fomos, foram serve both verbs; only context tells them apart.

rules.title: Vimos is a homograph
rules.text: vimos = 'we come' (vir, present) and 'we saw' (ver, PPS). viemos = 'we came'.

anchors.pt: De onde vens? — Venho do Porto.
anchors.en: Where are you coming from? — From Porto.

anchors.pt: O autocarro nunca vem a horas.
anchors.en: The bus never comes on time.
I came, I saw, I conquered.
How did you get here? — On foot.
It came at just the right moment.
Have they come? — Yes, they have.

anchors.pt: Não vê um palmo à frente do nariz.
anchors.en: He can't see past the end of his nose.

anchors.pt: O que os olhos não veem, o coração não sente.
anchors.en: What the eyes don't see, the heart doesn't feel.
I've never seen such a thing!

anchors.pt: Viste as minhas chaves? — Não vi.
anchors.en: Have you seen my keys? — No, I haven't.

anchors.pt: Quem te viu e quem te vê!
anchors.en: Look at you now! (lit. who saw you and who sees you)
Did you all see the game? — We did.

anchors.pt: Ele veio, viu e foi-se embora.
Viemos cá ontem e vimos tudo.
anchors.en: We came here yesterday and saw everything.
They came, saw, and didn't like it.

anchors.pt: Venho cá e vejo sempre o mesmo.
anchors.en: I come here and always see the same thing.

anchors.pt: Ele vem cá e vê os netos.
anchors.en: He comes here and sees the grandkids.

anchors.pt: Eles vêm cá e veem o jogo connosco.
anchors.en: They come over and watch the game with us.

anchors.pt: Fomos e viemos no mesmo dia.
anchors.en: We went and came back the same day.

anchors.pt: Foste tu? — Não fui eu, foi ele.
anchors.en: Was it you? — Not me, him.
We were there two years ago.

anchors.pt: Ele esteve doente e teve de ficar em casa.
anchors.en: He was ill and had to stay home.

anchors.pt: O homem põe e Deus dispõe.

anchors.en: We set the table at eight.

anchors.pt: Onde puseste as chaves? — Pus em cima da mesa.
anchors.en: Where did you put the keys? — On the table.
We put everything in the car.
They put the house up for sale.
I put everything wherever I could.
He put everything wherever he could.
We put everything wherever we could.
They put everything wherever they could.

anchors.pt: O que é que eu faço?
Fizeste tu? — Não fiz, fez ele.
anchors.en: Did you do it? — I didn't, he did.
I didn't want to bother anyone.
We didn't want to wake you.
They found out from the paper.
I'll bring the bill right away.

anchors.pt: O que o traz por cá?

anchors.en: Did you bring the umbrella? — I did.
Can you give me a lift?
It won't work. / No can do.
Shall we go for a walk?
